text: works, you should add some ux though to show that it is converting because for a moment i was wondering if it was doing anything or not
resolution: Added a blocking STL conversion overlay that appears immediately after selecting an STL, showing its filename, local Blender conversion status, activity bar, and an explicit wait/open-when-ready message. Conversion now gates editor input until it resolves. Verified editor bundle and ReleaseFast native editor build.
